requirements.condition: For every resource record.
requirements.required_behavior: Lay out the resource record fields in the order NAME, TYPE, CLASS, TTL, RDLENGTH, and RDATA.
requirements.why_checkable: A serializer or parser exposes the presence and order of the six fields.

requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding a resource record NAME field.
requirements.required_behavior: Treat NAME as a variable-length field.
requirements.why_checkable: The diagram marks NAME as variable length; field-boundary handling can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
NAME            an owner name, i.e., the name of the node to which this
                resource record pertains.
requirements.condition: When setting or interpreting a resource record NAME field.
requirements.required_behavior: Use NAME as the owner name identifying the node to which the resource record pertains.
requirements.why_checkable: Record ownership can be compared with the NAME emitted or parsed.

requirements.quote: TYPE            two octets containing one of the RR TYPE codes.
requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding a resource record TYPE field.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode TYPE in exactly two octets.
requirements.why_checkable: The wire field width is directly measurable.

requirements.quote: TYPE            two octets containing one of the RR TYPE codes.
requirements.condition: When setting or interpreting a resource record TYPE field.
requirements.required_behavior: Use a resource record TYPE code as the TYPE value.
requirements.why_checkable: The field value can be traced to the RR type-code representation.

requirements.quote: CLASS           two octets containing one of the RR CLASS codes.
requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding a resource record CLASS field.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode CLASS in exactly two octets.
requirements.why_checkable: The wire field width is directly measurable.

requirements.quote: CLASS           two octets containing one of the RR CLASS codes.
requirements.condition: When setting or interpreting a resource record CLASS field.
requirements.required_behavior: Use a resource record CLASS code as the CLASS value.
requirements.why_checkable: The field value can be traced to the RR class-code representation.

requirements.quote:
TTL             a 32 bit signed integer that specifies the time interval
                that the resource record may be cached before the source
                of the information should again be consulted.  Zero
requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding a resource record TTL field.
requirements.why_checkable: The TTL wire width can be measured in an encoded record.

requirements.quote:
TTL             a 32 bit signed integer that specifies the time interval
                that the resource record may be cached before the source
                of the information should again be consulted.  Zero
requirements.condition: When interpreting a resource record TTL field.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret TTL as a signed integer.
requirements.why_checkable: The signedness of TTL decoding and subsequent interpretation can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
TTL             a 32 bit signed integer that specifies the time interval
                that the resource record may be cached before the source
                of the information should again be consulted.  Zero
requirements.condition: When determining the caching interval for a resource record.
requirements.required_behavior: Use TTL to specify the time interval during which the resource record may be cached.
requirements.why_checkable: Cache lifetime calculations can be compared with the record TTL.

requirements.quote:
TTL             a 32 bit signed integer that specifies the time interval
                that the resource record may be cached before the source
                of the information should again be consulted.  Zero
requirements.condition: When the caching interval specified by a resource record TTL has elapsed.
requirements.required_behavior: The source of the information should again be consulted.
requirements.why_checkable: The expiration or refresh path can be inspected for the recommended source consultation.

requirements.quote:
Zero
                values are interpreted to mean that the RR can only be
                used for the transaction in progress, and should not be
                cached.
requirements.condition: When a resource record has a zero TTL.
requirements.required_behavior: Limit use of the resource record to the transaction in progress.
requirements.why_checkable: A zero-TTL record can be traced across the current and subsequent transactions.

requirements.quote:
Zero
                values are interpreted to mean that the RR can only be
                used for the transaction in progress, and should not be
                cached.
requirements.condition: When a resource record has a zero TTL.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The resource record should not be cached.
requirements.why_checkable: The zero-TTL cache insertion path can be checked against the stated recommendation.

requirements.quote:
For example, SOA records are always distributed
                with a zero TTL to prohibit caching.
requirements.condition: When distributing an SOA resource record.
requirements.required_behavior: Distribute the SOA record with a zero TTL.
requirements.why_checkable: The TTL on an emitted SOA record can be checked; the example states a general always-distributed rule.

requirements.quote:
Zero values can
                also be used for extremely volatile data.
requirements.condition: When assigning TTL to extremely volatile data.
requirements.required_behavior: A zero TTL may be used.
requirements.why_checkable: TTL assignment permits the explicitly allowed zero value without requiring all volatile data to use it.

requirements.quote:
RDLENGTH        an unsigned 16 bit integer that specifies the length in
                octets of the RDATA field.
requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding a resource record RDLENGTH field.
requirements.why_checkable: The RDLENGTH wire width can be measured.

requirements.quote:
RDLENGTH        an unsigned 16 bit integer that specifies the length in
                octets of the RDATA field.
requirements.condition: When interpreting a resource record RDLENGTH field.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret RDLENGTH as an unsigned integer.
requirements.why_checkable: RDLENGTH decoding can be checked for unsigned interpretation.

requirements.quote:
RDLENGTH        an unsigned 16 bit integer that specifies the length in
                octets of the RDATA field.
requirements.condition: When setting or interpreting a resource record RDLENGTH field.
requirements.required_behavior: Use RDLENGTH to specify the length of the RDATA field in octets.
requirements.why_checkable: The RDLENGTH value can be compared with the number of octets occupied by RDATA.

requirements.quote:
RDATA           a variable length string of octets that describes the
                resource.  The format of this information varies
                according to the TYPE and CLASS of the resource record.
requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding the RDATA field of a resource record.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent RDATA as a variable-length string of octets describing the resource.
requirements.why_checkable: The RDATA representation and its field boundaries can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
RDATA           a variable length string of octets that describes the
                resource.  The format of this information varies
                according to the TYPE and CLASS of the resource record.
requirements.condition: When determining the format of a resource record RDATA field.
requirements.required_behavior: Determine the RDATA format according to both the TYPE and CLASS of the resource record.
requirements.why_checkable: Format dispatch can be checked for dependence on the record TYPE and CLASS.
